scope: Template-owned neutral SmartList example and bundled Gothic landing typography. Native MyScoutee code unchanged by this batch.

checks.name: API bounded paging and anonymous denial
Fresh-browser local and HTTP entry + SmartList
assertions: view persisted in URL on reload
no handled Angular errors, browser exceptions or failed resources
local does not call backend; HTTP reads actual API

checks.name: Visual inspection
checks.font: UnifrakturMaguntia loaded from local bundled asset; original OFL license included

performance.limit: Single post-validation dev sample, not a matched stress comparison or proof of performance parity. Java and frontend compilers ran serially under existing watcher ownership; backend JUnit used the authorized isolated runner.

qualificationLimits: Production, installed DEB, Pages and published artifacts are not qualified by these checks.
The member header remains provisional until the avatar/chat shell steps; admin/operator remain empty guarded shells.
reproducingBrowserCheck: Use the native Chrome helper and entry assert with memberReady: assertShowcase; local:true at http://127.0.0.1:4200, local:false at http://localhost. Stop frontend-sync before starting the local frontend; stop the local owner before restarting frontend-sync.
